request.style: English, ballad, female solo voice with soft choir, piano, acoustic guitar, cello, strings, 70 BPM, reverent and hopeful
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I pray not for these alone today
But for those who will believe
Through the word that they convey
Into the world to receive

[Verse]
As you the Father are in me
And I am in you likewise
Let them be in us we see
In this holy, quiet space

[Chorus]
That they may all be one
As we are one, as we are one
Let the world believe it is done
That you sent me, and this is won

[Verse]
The glory you gave to me
I have given to them all
That they may be complete and free
In truth and in the call

[Chorus]
That they may all be one
As we are one, as we are one
Let the world believe it is done
That you sent me, and this is won

[Bridge]
I in them and you in me
Brought to complete unity
So the world may know with ease
That you loved them as I

[Outro]
That they may all be one
As you and I are one
